meta.notes: A 20 m low-floor streetcar, two sections and a pantograph (render/traffic-figures.ts draws it by its id), at a walking-pace-plus 9 m/s. It holds its lane and never changes lanes, so you pass it on the other one. Big: hitting one crashes you. Playtest 3, T10.5 (the real-world spec's section 6): in no region mix, only in downtown Portland's traffic area (the `pdx-blocks` road tag). The plan wanted it only on the `rail-line` stretch, but the one baked rail road, Grand Avenue, is on the Morrison Bridge choice, which carries no traffic, so a streetcar there would never spawn; the area is the whole downtown for now and the rails are the render lane's to draw.
